summary: LangSwitcher component is small, focused, and fully Decision 12 compliant. It calls only `await setLocale(code)` with no `navigateTo`/`switchLocalePath`/`useSwitchLocalePath`, applies the documented Tailwind active-state classes (`font-semibold text-primary` vs. `text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground`), guards the active-locale click with an early return, and exposes `data-test`, `aria-label`, `aria-current`, and `type="button"` per the spec. No blocking findings; two non-blocking polish suggestions only.

non_blocking_findings.issue: Double cast `(locales.value as unknown as LocaleEntry[])` bypasses the @nuxtjs/i18n v9 typings, which already declare `locales` as `ComputedRef<LocaleObject[] | string[]>`. The double-`unknown` cast hides any future typing drift from the module.
non_blocking_findings.impact: Minor — runtime behavior unaffected; the filter is defensive. But the pattern silently accepts a structural mismatch instead of using the module's exported `LocaleObject` type, which would catch a future contract change at compile time.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Optional: import `LocaleObject` from `@nuxtjs/i18n` (or `vue-i18n-routing`) and narrow with `(locales.value as LocaleObject[]).filter(l => typeof l === 'object' && (l.code === 'uk' || l.code === 'en'))`. Acceptable to keep current form given the local scope.

non_blocking_findings.issue: `aria-current="true"` is valid but `aria-current="page"` is the more semantically precise token for navigation-style toggles in WAI-ARIA 1.2. Not strictly required by the task (tech-spec only says `aria-current` without specifying a value).
non_blocking_findings.impact: Screen readers announce both, but `"page"` more accurately conveys "this is the currently active page/locale view". `"true"` is the generic fallback.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Optional: switch to `:aria-current="isActive(item.code) ? 'page' : undefined"` if the team prefers stricter ARIA semantics. Current form satisfies the AC.
